title: Are You Ready to Start a Business?
intro: Answer 7 quick questions to see how well your current habits, goals, and mindset line up with starting a business. This is a self-reflection tool for general education and fun, not financial or legal advice.

questions.q: How specific is the business idea you have in mind right now?

options.t: I know the product, who it's for, and how I'd earn from it
I have a general direction but the details are fuzzy
I just like the idea of working for myself someday

questions.q: If your income dropped to zero tomorrow, how long could you cover your basic living costs?

options.t: Several months or more of cushion set aside
A few weeks, with some belt-tightening
I'd be in trouble almost right away

questions.q: How do you tend to handle a project with no boss, no deadline, and no one checking on you?

options.t: I set my own goals and reliably follow through
I get going eventually but need a nudge sometimes
Without structure, things usually stall out

questions.q: How do you feel about not knowing exactly what you'll earn from one month to the next?

options.t: I'm comfortable with ups and downs if the upside is mine
It makes me nervous but I think I could adjust
A predictable paycheck matters a lot to my peace of mind

questions.q: Have you talked to anyone who might actually pay for what you'd offer?

options.t: Yes, and a few have said they would buy it
I've floated the idea casually to friends or family
Not yet, it's still just in my head

questions.q: How do you usually respond when an early attempt at something flops?

options.t: I treat it as data and adjust my next try
It stings, but I bounce back after a bit
A setback like that tends to make me want to quit

questions.q: What does your support system look like for a venture like this?

options.t: People around me are on board and ready to cheer me on
Some support, though a few folks have doubts
I'd mostly be going it alone right now

results.title: Starting a business might not be your easiest path right now
results.body: Your answers suggest a few foundations are still being built, and that's completely okay. Rather than leaping in, this is a great moment to firm up an idea, grow a small savings cushion, or test interest in a low-stakes way on the side. Treat the next few months as preparation, not a closed door.

results.title: You could be ready to start a business, with a plan
results.body: You already have several traits that serve founders well, and a couple of gaps worth closing before you go all in. A simple written plan, a longer runway, or a handful of real conversations with potential customers could move you from 'maybe' to 'go.' You're closer than you might think.

results.title: You look like a strong candidate to start a business
results.body: Your habits, mindset, and groundwork all point in the same direction. You have an idea with legs, a tolerance for uncertainty, and the follow-through to keep going when things get bumpy. The biggest risk now is waiting too long, so dig into the practical mechanics and start taking deliberate steps.

disclaimer: This quiz is for general education and self-reflection, not financial or legal advice. It does not assess your specific situation. Consult a qualified professional before making major business or financial decisions.
